stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: Why is Innes on the desk's list too?
stations.note: One list, two people changing it.

stations.title: Booking desk
stations.text: Hands over its own list, not a copy

stations.title: Your lists
stations.gap: Every change lands on every list

stations.title: Gangway
stations.say: Innes is on, the desk's list is fine
stations.note: Each list changes only where it should.

captions: The gangway. Bridie adds a late passenger to the Gannet's boarding list.
Today the desk's own list grows too, and the wrong seat comes free.
You write a copy of its own, free a seat by its number, and void tickets safely.
Now Innes boards, the desk's list stays as it was, and every voided ticket goes.
Lists that change only where they should. Next: Ossian's evening tally.
